tests.name: the native PDF worker identifies the main and supporting-information PDF locally
content overrides generic filenames and the published paper outranks an earlier accepted manuscript
the batch picker is immediately usable and a manual override remains available
duplicate PDFs are read once and equal published versions select one stable candidate
existing verified parser caches are reused without invoking the local PDF worker
source changes invalidate old hints and extraction is capped at two pages
supplemental-only groups stay unselected while extraction errors fall back to explicit filename version hints
inspection never changes PDFs, notes or collections and never sends a reading or upload request
